instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. Indoors against a plain white wall, the blonde woman in the beige hoodie (R2) on the left and the dark-haired woman in the orange hoodie (R1) on the right stand in profile facing each other. They high-five with their raised hands while jointly holding a yellow sign that reads "WOMEN'S RIGHTS ARE HUMAN RIGHTS" at waist level. Both women are smiling. The scene is illuminated by bright, soft, diffused studio lighting with a neutral color palette.
elements: R1 is the dark-haired woman in the orange hoodie raising a hand to high-five R2
R2 is the blonde woman in the beige hoodie raising a hand to meet R1's high-five
R1 and R2 face each other in profile while their raised hands meet in a high-five
R1 and R2 jointly hold a yellow protest sign at waist level during the high-five
The yellow sign reads "WOMEN'S RIGHTS ARE HUMAN RIGHTS"
The scene is indoors against a plain white wall
